verdict.rationale: Omarchy ships an official `omarchy` CLI (documented at /manual/omarchy-cli/) explicitly framed as AI-agent-friendly: docs state 'you can also control it through the omarchy CLI... particularly helpful when you're having an AI agent work with you on customization or configuration,' plus commands like `omarchy-snapshot create` and `omarchy windows key`. Missing for 10: independent hands-on validation of the CLI's agent-facing behavior and a fuller command reference beyond a few examples.
